body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/bugs.md (entry dated 2026-09-22).

At 82a113a, `go test ./internal/specindex` fails with ten mismatches: `docs/specs/INDEX.json` disagrees with the spec header and/or `docs/specs/README.md` row for `daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md` (delivery, digest status, README status, README first clause), `use-case-conformance-v0.md` (digest status, README status) and `protected-pi-runtime-v0.md` (claim, digest status, README status, README first clause). The test passes at `main` (cd9fec9); the drift arrived with `8013807`, `8b19418` and `abd10d5`/`830e7e3`, none of which updated `INDEX.json`. It went unnoticed because the gate skipped `go-test` (entry above). Done looks like: `INDEX.json` realigned with the three specs' headers and README rows, `go test ./internal/specindex` green on the release branch.
title: docs: INDEX.json disagrees with three spec headers on the 0.6 release branch
